req.title: Reject invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 400 when the status code path segment is not a valid integer.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<non-integer> must return HTTP 400. The source code in view_status_code() catches ValueError from int(codes) and returns Response('Invalid status code', status=400). Tests must: (1) confirm a valid integer code returns the correct status (positive/EP), (2) confirm a purely alphabetic segment returns 400 with exact body text (negative/NEG), (3) probe boundary inputs like empty-ish strings, mixed alphanumeric, and special characters (boundary/BVA), and (4) confirm the comma-separated weighted path also rejects non-integers (DT). Assertions use exact status codes and exact response body text to kill constant-mutation and string-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_correct_status
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
Response does not contain 'Invalid status code'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-015: valid integer path segment must NOT trigger the 400 error path
Catches mutations that flip the ValueError branch condition
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_correct_status():
    r = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Invalid status code' not in r.data
